title: Mad Props: Parallelism in Markov Chain Monte Carlo Through the Lens of the Infinite Proposal Limit
summary: Multiproposal MCMC (MP-MCMC) algorithms use clouds of proposals to efficiently traverse state spaces and overcome complex target geometries. While MCMC methods are embarrassingly parallel by nature, the non-trivial forms of parallelism provided by the MP-MCMC formalism sometimes leads to significant improvements over a naive approach. Here, one important tuning parameter is the number of proposals p used by a single MP-MCMC iteration.
